task_description: As a student, your task is to find out how many hidden directories are in your home directory and the current working directory, which is initially set to a visible subdirectory in your home directory. Note that a hidden directory starts with a dot ('.').

args.script:
echo "Home directory: $HOME"
echo "Current working directory: $(pwd)"
echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in home directory ==="
ls -la $HOME | grep "^d" | grep "\." | head -50
echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in home (count) ==="
find $HOME -maxdepth 1 -type d -name ".*" | wc -l
echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in current working directory ==="
ls -la . | grep "^d" | grep "\." | head -50
echo ""
echo "=== Hidden directories in current working directory (count) ==="
find . -maxdepth 1 -type d -name ".*" | wc -l
